jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

Job Description

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

What Fiix Business Systems Does

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

Your Responsibilities

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.

Strategy & Roadmap

Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.
Typically requires 8 years of management experience.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

Proven track record of stabilizing and scaling business systems or revenue operations in a high-demand environment with a significant backlog.
Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).
Experience in a SaaS or subscription software business, including CPQ, subscription billing, renewals and revenue recognition processes.
Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.
You can explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.
Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.
Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud / revenue management, and commerce platforms.

What We Offer:

401k
Paid Time off
Parental and Caregiver Leave
Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

jobs.description:
Job Description

A Director of Technology is a software engineering expert who leads the design, architecture, and high-quality delivery of enterprise technology solutions. This role will be focused on driving technology transformation for a leading North American retail and grocery organization, bringing deep expertise in modern enterprise architecture, integration frameworks, cloud platforms, full-stack engineering, data, and AI.

The ideal candidate will combine strong retail domain knowledge with hands-on technology leadership and the ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable, future-ready technology solutions. They will lead engineering teams, collaborate with senior client stakeholders (up to C-suite), and work closely with Publicis Sapient s consulting, product, and delivery teams to shape and deliver strategic business outcomes.

They will bring a strong point of view on modern technology trends, particularly event-driven architectures, Kafka-based integration ecosystems, cloud-native platforms, and Agentic AI. They will also play a key role in identifying new opportunities, shaping solutions, and driving technology-led business growth.

Your Impact

Immerse yourself in the client s retail and grocery business objectives, technology landscape, and strategic priorities to define future-state architecture, technology roadmaps, and transformation strategies.
Lead enterprise-scale technology transformation initiatives across retail and grocery, covering areas such as merchandising, pricing, promotions, inventory, supply chain, order management, e-commerce, and customer experience.
Drive the design and implementation of modern, scalable integration architectures leveraging Kafka and event-driven integration frameworks to enable real-time data exchange across enterprise applications.
Lead the adoption of AI and Agentic AI capabilities, including the design and development of agentic platforms that automate complex business processes and enable intelligent decision-making.
Define and drive cloud-native architecture and engineering strategies, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its ecosystem.
Provide technology leadership across full-stack engineering teams, ensuring high standards of architecture, engineering excellence, scalability, performance, and security.
Collaborate with senior client technology and business leaders to identify opportunities, shape technology solutions, and translate business priorities into executable transformation roadmaps.
Drive solution architecture, technical proposals, estimations, and solutioning for new opportunities, RFPs, and strategic account initiatives.
Partner with Publicis Sapient s consulting, data, AI, and engineering practices to develop differentiated solutions and accelerate client transformation.
Contribute to account growth by identifying opportunities for technology-led transformation, innovation, and new business development.
Mentor and inspire engineering leaders and technical teams, building a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Qualifications

Qualifications - Skills, Experience & Differentiators

You will possess extensive experience in the retail industry, with a strong understanding of retail business processes, technology ecosystems, and enterprise transformation. Grocery retail experience will be a significant advantage.
You will have demonstrated experience leading large-scale technology transformation programs for enterprise retail organizations.
You will be experienced in influencing senior client stakeholders (up to C-suite) and building trusted relationships across business and technology leadership.
You will bring a strong point of view on modern retail technology trends and the ability to translate emerging technologies into tangible business value.
You will have experience defining enterprise technology strategies, architecture roadmaps, and transformation initiatives aligned with business objectives.
You will be experienced in leading distributed engineering organizations and managing complex technology delivery across multiple teams and geographies.
You will have the ability to navigate ambiguity, lead solutioning initiatives, and drive architecture decisions, estimations, and technology choices during different stages of RFPs and client engagements.
You will demonstrate strong consulting and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technology concepts to both business and technical audiences.
You will have experience identifying opportunities for innovation, developing technology propositions, and contributing to account growth.

Your Technology & Engineering Skills

You have extensive experience defining end-to-end enterprise architecture and leading complex, distributed application development using modern technology stacks.
You possess strong knowledge of integration architecture and modern integration frameworks, particularly event-driven architecture and Apache Kafka, including Kafka-based streaming, messaging, and real-time integration patterns.
You have deep understanding of microservices, API-led architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event sourcing, and distributed systems.
You bring strong experience in designing and implementing Agentic AI platforms and solutions, leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.
You understand the architecture and engineering principles behind AI agents, including reasoning, planning, orchestration, memory, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and enterprise integration.
You have hands-on experience leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and enterprise AI platforms to build production-grade AI solutions.
You possess strong knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native architecture, GKE, serverless technologies, data services, and AI/ML capabilities such as Vertex AI.
You bring extensive full-stack engineering leadership experience, with a strong understanding of modern front-end and back-end technologies, frameworks, and development practices.
You have a strong understanding of data architecture and engineering concepts, including data modelling, data integration, streaming, data pipelines, and modern data platforms. Experience with retail data ecosystems is an advantage.
You have experience designing and building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise applications using programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
You have strong knowledge of API management, integration patterns, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
You understand DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, site reliability engineering, and modern engineering practices required to operate enterprise-scale platforms.
You have experience evaluating emerging technologies and establishing architecture standards, engineering best practices, and technology governance across large development organizations.

By employing lower shipping costs to offer compelling customer pricing, the initiative aims to drive adoption, influence customer behavior, and unlock new growth opportunities, all while strengthening operational efficiency and long-term unit economics.

This role leads the economic architecture of the low cost shipping business. You will own the business recommendation on pricing, subsidy, unit economics, contribution, and the economic conditions required to launch, expand, or change course.

The role sits at the intersection of customer behavior and physical network economics: understanding how cost changes with parcel flow and density, how buyers and sellers respond to price, and whether lower shipping prices create incremental marketplace activity rather than simply subsidizing existing transactions.

What You Will Accomplish

Manage the end-to-end economic model for low cost shipping, including partner rates, network costs, buyer pricing, subsidy, contribution, and fixed and variable investment
Understand economics at the level that decisions are actually made: by market, parcel flow, customer cohort, partner, and network stage rather than relying on blended averages
Define buyer-facing pricing and subsidy recommendations that balance adoption, incrementality, contribution economics, and the long-term path to structurally lower shipping cost
Establish the economic thresholds that determine when the business should STOP, SLOW, or EXPAND, including break-even volume, density, utilization, and subsidy requirements
Develop a deep understanding of price sensitivity, incrementality, cohort response, and experiment outcomes; continuously update the economic thesis as customer behavior becomes observable
Distinguish incremental marketplace value from shipment substitution. Determine whether pricing changes are creating incremental conversion, frequency, GMV, or low-ASP TAM rather than simply moving existing volume or buying adoption
Build scenarios and sensitivities that show how partner rates, flow mix, density, node utilization, customer behavior, and network design change the economics and required investment
Translate the analysis into clear business recommendations for senior leaders on pricing, investment, network expansion, partner economics, and market sequencing

What You Will Bring

Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to personally work through complex financial, operational, customer, and network data rather than relying solely on prepared analysis. SQL or equivalent analytical capability is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of pricing, elasticity, experimentation, incrementality, unit economics, contribution economics, and sensitivity analysis
Experience building economic models where customer behavior and cost structure interact — ideally in marketplaces, logistics, transportation, consumer pricing, or another network business
Ability to distinguish correlation from causality and design or interpret experiments that can support pricing and investment decisions
Strong commercial judgment: able to translate detailed analysis into a recommendation, identify the few assumptions that actually drive the answer, and state what evidence would change the recommendation
Ability to challenge partner cost structures, operating assumptions, forecasts, and internally generated business cases rather than treating supplied inputs as fixed
Demonstrated ability to influence Finance, Product, Analytics, Growth, Operations, and senior leadership without direct authority
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced quantitative training is useful but not required

How We Will Measure Success

Success means we can answer, with increasing confidence: what does each parcel flow actually cost, what customer price changes behavior, how much subsidy is required, how much demand is incremental, and at what volume and density the network becomes structurally advantaged.

The role succeeds when better economics allow us to sustainably lower customer shipping prices and unlock incremental marketplace activity — not simply when low cost shipping volume increases or the modeled P&L improves.

About Fort Mcmurray Airport Authority (fmaa)

The Fort McMurray International Airport (YMM) is owned and operated by the Fort McMurray Airport Authority. YMM

connects the world to Fort McMurray Wood Buffalo. The airport is a major economic driver for the region, with an economic

impact of over $290 million, supporting 40+ businesses and 500 jobs on the airport campus.

In 1999, the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (RMWB) created the Regional Airport Commission to take ownership of

the airport from the federal government. The Fort McMurray Airport was later incorporated as an Airport Authority in

December 2009. The first Airport Authority Board was formed in January 2010, to become the Fort McMurray Airport Authority

(FMAA). The newly formed organization acquired the airport from the RMWB.

Today, the FMAA is an independent not-for-profit non-share capital corporation which owns and operates the Fort McMurray

International Airport. FMAA provides critical transportation services, creating local jobs, procuring local goods and services

and offering commercial land leasing opportunities. All surplus revenue generated from commercial activities is reinvested

back into airport operations and infrastructure to ensure compliance with safety, security and environmental regulations.

About The Role

Reporting to the CEO, the Director, Business Development is responsible for identifying and advancing opportunities that

strengthen the Fort McMurray International Airport’s revenue, connectivity, and long-term sustainability. The Director will

lead business development activities across aviation and non-aviation revenue streams, including air service development,

commercial leasing, land development, concessions, advertising, parking, and strategic partnerships.

As part of a small and collaborative airport leadership team, the Director will work closely with Operations, Finance,

Infrastructure, Communications, and other functional areas to assess opportunities and move viable initiatives from concept

through negotiation and implementation. The role will also build productive relationships with airlines, tenants,

government, tourism organizations, economic development partners, Indigenous communities, and businesses throughout

the Wood Buffalo region.

The ideal candidate will be commercially minded, relationship-focused, and comfortable moving between strategy and

hands-on execution. They will understand how to develop a persuasive business case, negotiate agreements, manage

several opportunities at once, and represent the airport professionally within the community and aviation sector. Success

will require initiative, sound judgment, persistence, and an ability to identify practical opportunities that align with the

airport’s operational capacity, regulatory obligations, and community mandate.

BUSINESS AND COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT

Lead commercial negotiations and support the development of leases, licences, service agreements, and partnership arrangements.

AIR SERVICE DEVELOPMENT

Coordinate airline presentations, route development proposals, and airport familiarization activities.
Work with regional partners to demonstrate market demand and strengthen the airport’s value proposition.

Support collaborative marketing initiatives that increase awareness and use of available air services.

PARTNERSHIPS AND STAKEHOLDER RELATIONS

Attend industry events, trade shows, conferences, and community activities.
Develop relationships with municipal, provincial, and federal government representatives and agencies.
Work with tourism, economic development, Indigenous, industry, and community organizations on shared priorities.
Identify grants, funding, sponsorship, and partnership opportunities that support airport development.

Fort McMurray Airport Authority (FMAA) Business Development Director

Act as a primary point of contact for prospective commercial partners and guide opportunities through internal review.
Promote the airport’s contribution to regional connectivity, economic development, employment, and investment attraction.

LEADERSHIP AND ORGANIZATIONAL SUPPORT

Contribute to strategic planning, annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and organizational reporting.
Establish measurable business development targets and monitor performance against approved plans.
Coordinate cross-functional project teams to evaluate and implement approved commercial initiatives.

Skills And Qualifications

7+ years of progressive experience in business development, commercial management, economic development, real estate, tourism, transportation, or aviation.
Experience developing and implementing business development or revenue-generation strategies.
Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, prepare business cases, and move initiatives from concept to implementation.

Proven ability to develop productive relationships with businesses, government, community organizations, and senior decision maker stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and opportunities within a small, resource-conscious organization.
Strong judgment and ability to balance commercial objectives with operational, regulatory, and community considerations.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, customer relationship management systems, and business reporting tools.

jobs.description:
Nous vous invitons à soumettre votre curriculum vitæ en français. Lorsqu'une version anglaise est disponible, vous pouvez également la joindre afin de faciliter les échanges avec certaines équipes de notre organisation internationale.

We invite you to submit your résumé in French. When an English version is available, you may also include it to facilitate communication with certain teams within our international organization.

Le Rôle

Se joindre à Moderna, c’est faire progresser la science de l’ARNm pour transformer la médecine.

Travaillez avec des équipes mondiales exceptionnelles sur un vaste portefeuille de programmes et bâtissez une carrière qui fait une réelle différence pour les patients.

À Laval, le partenariat à long terme de Moderna avec le gouvernement du Canada renforce la préparation du pays face aux pandémies. Notre installation de fabrication de vaccins à ARNm permettra un accès rapide à des vaccins respiratoires produits au pays. Grâce au développement des talents locaux et à la collaboration en recherche, nous bâtissons un solide écosystème de l’ARNm au Canada. Joignez-vous à nous pour façonner l’avenir de la biotechnologie et de l’innovation en santé.

Il s’agit d’une occasion hautement stratégique à titre de contributeur individuel, qui vous permettra de façonner la manière dont la formation, le développement des capacités et l’habilitation des processus sont déployés à l’échelle mondiale au sein de l’organisation Développement de Moderna. Vous établirez des approches évolutives permettant de traduire des processus complexes de développement clinique, des exigences procédurales, des attentes réglementaires et des changements organisationnels en expériences d’apprentissage percutantes qui renforcent l’excellence opérationnelle, la conformité, la préparation aux inspections et l’efficacité de la main-d’œuvre.

À l’intersection des responsables de processus d’affaires, de la Qualité, de la Documentation contrôlée, des Opérations cliniques, des Affaires médicales, de l’Innocuité, de la Gestion des données, des Affaires réglementaires et des autres fonctions de Développement, vous établirez un lien entre la conception des processus et les connaissances et compétences requises pour assurer une exécution efficace. Vous contribuerez également à faire progresser l’écosystème d’apprentissage de Moderna au moyen de technologies d’apprentissage numérique, de mesures fondées sur les données pour évaluer l’efficacité de la formation ainsi que de capacités émergentes, notamment l’intelligence artificielle générative, afin d’améliorer l’accès aux connaissances, le développement de contenu, la personnalisation de l’apprentissage et l’habilitation des employés.

Le rôle combine stratégie à l’échelle de l’entreprise et exécution concrète : mise en place de cadres de formation à l’échelle de Développement et propres aux essais cliniques, accompagnement de l’adoption du changement, gouvernance des évaluations d’incidence sur la formation, renforcement des pratiques de gestion des compétences et des connaissances, et assurance que les employés, les contractuels et les partenaires externes disposent des connaissances, des compétences et des outils nécessaires pour mener les activités de recherche clinique conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux normes de Moderna.

Voici Ce Que Vous Ferez

Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale de formation, d’apprentissage et de développement des capacités pour l’organisation Développement.
Concevoir et améliorer des programmes de formation basés sur les rôles et les essais cliniques, en assurant leur conformité, gouvernance et évolutivité.
Collaborer avec les équipes Qualité, Processus d’affaires et Documentation afin d’intégrer les exigences de formation aux processus, aux changements organisationnels et à la documentation contrôlée.
Diriger les évaluations d’impact de la formation liées aux SOP, politiques, systèmes et autres changements organisationnels.
Développer des stratégies soutenant l’intégration, le développement des compétences, la gestion des connaissances, la progression de carrière et la préparation aux inspections.
Représenter la fonction Développement dans les initiatives liées à la qualité, à la conformité, au contrôle des changements et aux programmes interfonctionnels.
Piloter les activités de gestion du changement afin de favoriser l’adoption de nouveaux processus et systèmes.
Mettre en place et suivre des indicateurs de performance et d’efficacité de la formation pour démontrer leur impact sur les résultats opérationnels.
Travailler avec les parties prenantes des fonctions cliniques, réglementaires, médicales, qualité et sécurité afin d’identifier les lacunes de compétences et de développer des solutions ciblées.
Assurer la gouvernance des programmes de formation liés aux essais cliniques mondiaux afin de maintenir conformité, traçabilité et préparation aux inspections.
Optimiser l’utilisation des LMS, des technologies d’apprentissage numériques et des nouvelles solutions technologiques pour améliorer l’expérience des apprenants et l’accès aux connaissances.
Explorer et intégrer des applications de l’intelligence artificielle générative pour renforcer le développement du contenu, la découverte des connaissances et la personnalisation de l’apprentissage.
Diriger les activités de préparation aux audits et inspections liées à la formation et à la gestion des compétences.
Gérer les partenariats externes soutenant le développement de contenu, la prestation de formation et les technologies d’apprentissage.
Promouvoir une culture d’amélioration continue, d’innovation, de partage des connaissances et d’excellence en apprentissage au sein de l’organisation Développement.

Les principaux Mindsets de Moderna dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle :

« Nous sommes obsédés par l’apprentissage. Nous n’avons pas besoin d’être les plus intelligents; nous devons apprendre le plus rapidement possible. »
« Nous faisons preuve d’une grande capacité d’adaptation, en menant de front la stratégie et l’exécution à chaque étape. »

Voici ce dont vous aurez besoin – qualifications de base :

Baccalauréat requis; diplôme d’études supérieures privilégié.
Minimum de 8 à 10 années d’expérience dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou de la recherche clinique.
Expérience importante dans la direction de programmes d’apprentissage, de formation, de développement des capacités organisationnelles ou d’habilitation des processus à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Expérience démontrée dans le soutien d’organisations de développement clinique assujetties aux bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC/GCP).
Solide compréhension des processus d’essais cliniques, des systèmes qualité, de la documentation contrôlée et des exigences de préparation aux inspections.
Expérience de collaboration avec la Qualité, les Opérations cliniques et les responsables de processus d’affaires afin de mettre en œuvre des initiatives liées aux processus et à la conformité.
Connaissance pratique des systèmes de gestion de l’apprentissage (LMS), des technologies d’apprentissage en ligne, de Veeva Vault et des plateformes d’apprentissage numérique.
Réussite démontrée dans la direction d’initiatives de gestion du changement associées à la transformation des processus, des technologies et de l’organisation.
Solides compétences analytiques et expérience dans l’élaboration d’indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), de tableaux de bord et de mesures de l’efficacité de la formation.
Compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication et en influence.
Capacité démontrée à diriger des initiatives interfonctionnelles au sein d’un environnement matriciel complexe.
Dans le cadre de l’engagement de Moderna à bâtir une main-d’œuvre durable, une autorisation de travail d’une durée minimale de deux ans est requise pour ce poste.

Notre modèle de travail

Depuis la création de notre entreprise, nous avons toujours considéré qu’une culture de travail en personne est essentielle à notre réussite.

Moderna valorise les avantages importants de la collaboration au bureau grâce à un modèle de travail 70/30. Cette structure, qui prévoit une présence au bureau 70 % du temps, contribue à favoriser une culture riche en innovation, en travail d’équipe et en mentorat direct. Joignez-vous à nous pour façonner un environnement où chaque interaction constitue une occasion d’apprendre, de contribuer et d’avoir un impact significatif.

Moderna offre un environnement de travail sans fumée, sans alcool et sans drogue.

The Role

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

In Laval, Moderna’s long term partnership with the Government of Canada is strengthening the country’s pandemic preparedness. Our mRNA vaccine manufacturing facility will support rapid access to respiratory vaccines produced domestically.Through local talent development and research collaboration, we are building a strong mRNA ecosystem in Canada. Join us in shaping the future of biotechnology and healthcare innovation.

This is a highly strategic individual-contributor opportunity to shape how learning, capability development, and process enablement operate across Moderna Development globally. You will establish scalable approaches that translate complex clinical-development processes, procedural requirements, regulatory expectations, and organizational change into impactful learning experiences that strengthen operational excellence, compliance, inspection readiness, and workforce effectiveness.

Working at the intersection of Business Process Owners, Quality, Controlled Documentation, Clinical Operations, Medical, Safety, Data Management, Regulatory, and other Development functions, you will connect process design with the knowledge and capabilities required for successful execution. Here’s What You’ll Do

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

Job Description

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

What Fiix Business Systems Does

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

Your Responsibilities

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.

Strategy & Roadmap

Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.
Typically requires 8 years of management experience.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

Proven track record of stabilizing and scaling business systems or revenue operations in a high-demand environment with a significant backlog.
Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).
Experience in a SaaS or subscription software business, including CPQ, subscription billing, renewals and revenue recognition processes.
Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.
You can explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.
Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.
Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud / revenue management, and commerce platforms.

401k
Paid Time off
Parental and Caregiver Leave
